node: Naval, submarine, and subsea niche components
summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Expanded the US-listed universe for direct naval/submarine/subsea niche-component exposure. The reference lane is anchored by L3Harris because it is an obvious undersea-warfare systems leader with towed-array sonar, submarine communications, and AUV launch/recovery exposure. The underfollowed lane surfaces Graham, Oceaneering, and Moog: smaller or less index-dominant industrial suppliers tied to Virginia/Columbia-class submarine components, SUBSAFE/submarine support equipment, and mission-critical naval actuation. This pass does not make any trading recommendation; it creates a Layer 1B candidate universe for later evidence verification, revenue-sizing, backlog quality, and valuation/market-pricing checks. Expanded the US-listed universe for naval/submarine/subsea niche components with a two-lane funnel. Reference context is Leonardo DRS, a larger listed naval power and propulsion supplier tied directly to Columbia-class submarine propulsion. The underfollowed lane surfaces Graham Corporation as a small-cap defense/process-equipment supplier with explicit Navy submarine program exposure. Two below-$300M speculative exceptions, Coda Octopus and Taylor Devices, are included because their public disclosures point to unusually direct niche exposure in underwater sonar/DAVD and submarine shock-isolation components, respectively. This is research support only, not a trading recommendation. Research-only Layer 1B expansion for the naval/submarine/subsea niche-components node.
